title: Motie van het lid Beckerman over een bevoegde instantie aanwijzen om ook deepfakeporno en andere onrechtmatige seksuele beelden offline te halen

reading.body:
Deepfake pornography was created and distributed on a website by digitally placing the faces of Dutch public figures onto pornographic footage without consent. The material remained accessible to millions of users while victims discovered it through public reporting rather than detection by the platform or authorities.

This is a failure of content moderation at deployment. The website hosting the material did not identify or remove non-consensual sexual imagery, and no automated system appears to have caught it before victims found themselves featured. What would have caught it: either platform moderation before publication, or detection systems scanning for known non-consensual deepfakes.

Whether the platform had policies prohibiting such content, how the material was initially uploaded, and what technical capabilities existed to prevent or detect it are not established from the reporting.

summary:
Several famous Dutch women are considering legal action after discovering themselves in fake pornographic videos posted on a website that receives 13 million monthly visitors. The manipulated content features the faces of Dutch entertainers, television presenters, Olympic athletes, government officials, and members of the royal family. The videos are created by digitally placing someone's head onto pornographic footage. The interim Justice Minister called the videos "disgusting" and urged victims to file reports with police.

Multiple victims have already filed complaints or are pursuing legal options. Creating such deepfake content falls under revenge porn laws and is illegal. Lawyers advise victims to report the material to authorities, who can attempt to shut down the websites hosting it. Other options include filing complaints with data protection authorities or contacting hosting companies. A previous case involved a television presenter whose attacker received a conditional 180-hour community sentence. Experts warn that without government intervention, more fake videos featuring public figures will continue to appear.
title_en: Motion by member Beckerman on designating a competent authority to also remove deepfake pornography and other unlawful sexual images offline
